description: This file defines an interface `ThreadSafeDittoLogger` that extends SLF4J's Logger and adds additional thread-safe methods for managing correlation IDs within log entries, utilizing MDC (Mapped Diagnostic Context). It provides methods for setting, deriving, retrieving, and discarding correlation IDs for consistent logging context management, specifically within an Akka-based service environment.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Sets a correlation ID for log entries on the logger, returning a new logger instance with this ID incorporated into MDC.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Derives a correlation ID from provided WithDittoHeaders and returns a logger with that ID set.

methods.name: withCorrelationId
methods.description: Retrieves a correlation ID from DittoHeaders and returns a logger configured with this ID, discarding any previous ID.

methods.name: discardCorrelationId
methods.description: Removes the current correlation ID from MDC, returning a logger without any correlation ID.
